title: Kernel benchmark record schemas
responsibility: Defines observational kernel benchmark records, their provenance and the measurements and runtime choice they contain.

outputs.name: measurementsDirectory
outputs.description: Repository-relative directory specification/measurements/impact-kernel used for kernel measurements.

outputs.name: representativeWorkload
outputs.description: The representative runtime-selection workload id, graph-1k.

outputs.name: calibrationNote
outputs.description: Notice that calibration measurements are observational and cannot establish or satisfy a verification budget baseline.

outputs.name: calibrationSchema
outputs.description: Strict Zod schema requiring kind calibration, verified false and a nonempty note.

outputs.name: benchMeasurementSchema
outputs.description: Measurement schema extended to allow a tested revision to be null; a present revision is a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit id.

outputs.name: kernelBenchmarkSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a version 1 kernel benchmark, including machine profile, source revision and dirty state, calibration provenance, workload sizes, measurements and measured or unmeasured runtime choice.
